body:
## Pensieve 0.6.7

### Fixed
- **Adding a to-do is easy to find.** On Today, Tasks and in projects, the field is now large and at the top of the list, with an *Add* button — and you can set the day, deadline, project, priority and time before adding it.
- **Dates can be typed.** Type "27", "10-31", "2026-11-03", "明天" or "周五" into any date field; Pensieve shows which day it understood. Typing a day no longer jumps between 02 and 07.
- **The sidebar stays still.** Its text no longer shifts when a scrollbar appears (for example while AI is working).

### New
- **Schedule: Add and Details.** Add an appointment with one click, or open the full form (date, time, place, repeat, reminder) already filled in from what you typed.

### Download

| Your system | File |
|---|---|
| Windows 10 / 11 | **Pensieve-Setup-0.6.7.exe** |
| Mac with Apple Silicon | **Pensieve-0.6.7-mac-arm64.zip** |
| Mac with Intel | **Pensieve-0.6.7-mac-x64.zip** |
| Linux (64-bit) | **Pensieve-0.6.7-linux-x86_64.AppImage** or **Pensieve-0.6.7-linux-amd64.deb** |
| Android 8+ (HarmonyOS via 卓易通) | **Pensieve-0.6.7-android.apk** |
| iPhone / iPad (iOS 15+) | **Pensieve-0.6.7-ios-unsigned.ipa** — install with Sideloadly or AltStore ([how](https://photonghost308.github.io/pensieve-app/#ios-install)) |

Already using Pensieve? It updates itself (Settings → General → Updates). Your notes stay as they are.
